name: DataConsumerPolicy
description: Policy for Data Consumer to perform operations on metadata entities

rules.name: DataConsumerPolicy-EditRule
rules.description: Allow some of the edit operations on a resource for everyone.

rules.name: DataConsumerPolicy-CreateTask-Rule
rules.description: Allow authenticated users to create tasks (data access requests, suggestions, etc.).

rules.name: DataConsumerPolicy-CreateConversation-Rule
rules.description: Allow authenticated users to create conversations and replies.

rules.name: DataConsumerPolicy-TaskRule
rules.description: Allow authenticated users to file and edit tasks (data access requests, suggestions, etc.) against any entity. Restrict this rule (e.g. with an isOwner condition) to limit who can file or edit tasks on which entities.

rules.name: DataConsumerPolicy-ExecuteSparqlQuery-Rule
rules.description: Allow authenticated users to run read-only SPARQL queries through the agent SPARQL endpoint. The endpoint does not filter results by asset, so remove this rule if viewing is restricted through custom policies.

rules.name: DataConsumerPolicy-CreateContextMemory-Rule
rules.description: Allow authenticated users to create context memories, including the ones the AI agent saves from their conversations. The creator owns a new memory and can edit or delete it. An Entity memory is shown to everyone who can view its asset, or to everyone when it has no asset, so remove this rule if only admins should create memories.
